tagline.en: Tainan to Taitung over the Central Mountain Range at 2,722 m, broken for nearly thirteen years after Typhoon Morakot
tagline.zh: 自台南越过海拔 2,722 米的中央山脉至台东，莫拉克风灾后中断近十三年

start.en: Zhongshan Road by Tang Te-chang Memorial Park, West Central District, Tainan, signed as kilometre zero
start.zh: 台南市中西区汤德章纪念公园中山路段，立有南横公路 0K 告示牌

end.en: Degao, on the Haiduan–Guanshan boundary in Taitung, where it meets Provincial Highway 9
end.zh: 台东县海端乡与关山镇交界的德高，衔接台 9 线

en: Provincial Highway 20 runs 203.982 km from the centre of Tainan to Degao in the Huadong valley. From the plain it climbs through Jiaxian, Liugui, Baolai and Taoyuan in Kaohsiung up the Laonong River, crosses the main ridge of the Central Mountain Range at Yakou through the Daguanshan tunnel, 2,722 m, the highest point on the road, and descends past Xiangyang, Lidao and Wulu to the east.

It is the southernmost of the three cross-island highways, and the most fragile. More than three-fifths of the road is above 1,000 m, through old, deeply weathered rock. The road passes through Yushan National Park and through Bunun, Lha'alua and Taivoan country; several rebuilt bridges carry Indigenous names.
zh: 台 20 线自台南市中心至花东纵谷的德高，全长 203.982 公里。它离开平原后经高雄甲仙、六龟、宝来、桃源，沿荖浓溪上溯，在垭口以大关山隧道（海拔 2,722 米，全线最高点）穿越中央山脉主脊，再经向阳、利稻、雾鹿东下。
它是三条横贯公路中最南、也最脆弱的一条：逾六成路段位于海拔一千米以上，穿越古老地层，风化严重。公路穿过玉山国家公园，沿线是布农族、拉阿鲁哇族与大武垅族的家园，灾后重建的几座桥梁都以原住民族语命名。

en: It was built to the standards of the Central Cross-Island Highway and, like it, largely by hand. Most of the line was new road. Supplies and food were carried up on foot by the local Indigenous people. In the 1958 plan the longest concrete bridge was 25 m and longer crossings were to be suspension bridges; the later survey plan provided for 54 new bridges on 167.5 km of new road.

It was not paved when it opened. Asphalt was laid section by section from both ends towards Yakou between 1983 and 1996, and from the 1980s rock sheds were built where slopes kept falling on the road; the Meilan rock shed was the first.

After Typhoon Morakot the rebuilding moved the road off the riverbeds. Where the Laonong had raised its bed by up to 50 m and buried the road and tunnels, new high viaducts and re-aligned bridges were built: Shengjing bridge 50 m above the old road, Taoyuan No. 1 across a deep valley into Taoyuan, and the Mingbakelu bridge, finished in April 2017, which replaced a riverbed detour.
zh: 它比照中部横贯公路的标准兴建，也同样大体依靠人力。全线大部分是新辟道路，施工期间的物料与粮食多由当地原住民徒步背负上山。1958 年的计划中，混凝土桥最长只有 25 米，较长的跨越仍以吊桥为主；其后的勘查规划则在 167.5 公里新辟路段上新建桥梁 54 座。
通车时尚未铺设柏油。公路局自 1983 年至 1996 年间，由东西两端向垭口逐年分段铺设沥青路面；自 1980 年代起，又在边坡屡屡崩落之处修建明隧道，梅兰明隧道是南横第一座。
莫拉克风灾后的重建，让公路离开河床。荖浓溪河道淤高达 50 米、埋没路面与隧道之处，改建高架桥并截弯取直：胜境桥架在原路上方 50 米，桃源一桥跨越大河谷连接桃源市区，2017 年 4 月完工的明霸克露桥则取代了河底便道。

en: The route follows the Japanese Guanshan crossing trail, a police road for controlling the mountain peoples, from Beiliao in Tainan to Haiduan in Taitung. After 1945 the province studied three Japanese-era crossings and in 1958 chose the Tainan–Taitung line, at an estimated NT$228.1 million; then it shelved the scheme, because the Central and Northern Cross-Island Highways were already under way and money was short.

Chiang Kai-shek revived it. In May 1966 he told the provincial governor, Huang Chieh, that the road should be built, and in June 1967 told him again to plan it quickly. Ground was broken on 5 July 1968 at Beiliao in Nanhua, Tainan. The highways bureau set up a western engineering office at Jiaxian and an eastern one at Guanshan, and the two ends were driven towards each other.

Retired servicemen of the RSEA engineering agency did the roadwork, more than 2,000 at the peak, with men from the Garrison Command's vocational training corps and army labour on the most dangerous mountain work, and private firms building bridges. In 1972 about 3,400 people were on site. 116 workers died; the Changqing shrine at Tianchi commemorates them.

The road was completed on 31 October 1972 after four years and four months, and opened to traffic on 1 December, when tunnel walls and other small works were done. Entering it required a mountain permit until the controls were lifted in 1993.

Typhoon Morakot in August 2009 broke the road apart. The mountain section between Meishankou and Xiangyang stayed closed for years; in 2018 it was downgraded to a temporary road, Highway 20 Lin 105. The whole road reopened at 7 a.m. on 1 May 2022.
zh: 路线沿用日治时期的理蕃警备道“关山越岭道”，自台南北寮至台东海端。战后省府勘查了三条日治时期的横贯道路，1958 年选定台南至台东线，概估经费新台币 2 亿 2,810 万元；但因中横、北横已陆续动工，财源吃紧，计划随即搁置。
是蒋中正让它重新启动。1966 年 5 月，他召见台湾省主席黄杰，指示南横仍应修建；1967 年 6 月再度指示“应从速计划修建”。1968 年 7 月 5 日，在台南县南化乡北寮举行开工典礼。省公路局设西段工程处于甲仙、东段工程处于关山，由两端同时向中间推进。
路面工程由退辅会所属的荣民工程事业处承作，全盛时期施工荣民逾两千人；最险峻的高山工程另调警备总部职训总队与陆军协建人员施工，桥梁则发包民营厂商。1972 年工地人员约三千四百人。施工期间共有 116 名工作人员罹难，天池建有长青祠纪念。
历时四年四个月，南横于 1972 年 10 月 31 日完工，待隧道侧壁等零星工程完成后，于 12 月 1 日开放通车。进入公路沿线须申请入山证，直到 1993 年解除山地管制。
2009 年 8 月莫拉克台风使南横柔肠寸断。梅山口至向阳的山区路段长年封闭，2018 年降级为临时便道“台 20 临 105 线”。2022 年 5 月 1 日上午 7 时，南横全线复通。

en: When work began the estimate was NT$311 million: NT$114.1 million for roadbed, NT$90.7 million for bridges, culverts and tunnels, NT$33.2 million for protective works and the rest for paving, ancillary works and management.

It was meant to be paid with Sino-American Fund grants and loans plus provincial money, but the fund had nothing left for large projects, and Chiang Kai-shek directed that the Bank of Taiwan lend it instead. The provincial treasury put in NT$10 million and the Forestry Bureau NT$40 million in 1969; the 1970–1972 budgets, NT$76 million, NT$110 million and NT$120 million, were borrowed by the provincial government from the Bank of Taiwan; World Food Programme supplies were valued at NT$41 million; the Forestry Bureau covered the remaining NT$71.842 million. Paying back the road through logging along it shaped how the area was later developed.
zh: 开工时的工程概算为新台币 3 亿 1,100 万元：路基工程 1 亿 1,409 万余元，桥涵隧道工程 9,074 万元，防护工程 3,318 万元，其余为路面、附属工程与管理费等。

原规划以经合会管理的中美基金赠款与贷款，搭配台湾省府自筹经费支应，但中美基金资源有限，已无法补助大型建设，蒋中正遂指示改由台湾银行贷款。1969 年度由省库支出 1,000 万元、林务局拨付 4,000 万元；1970 至 1972 年度预算 7,600 万元、1 亿 1,000 万元、1 亿 2,000 万元，均由省府向台湾银行举债；另有世界粮食计划署物资估值 4,100 万元，不足的 7,184 万 2,000 元由林务局年度预算列支。路成之后如何开发沿线森林以偿付开路经费，也就成了影响南横日后发展规划的因素之一。

en: The mountain section, Highway 20 Lin 105 from Meishankou to Xiangyang, is closed every Tuesday and Thursday; on other days vehicles may enter only from 7:00 to 14:00 and must be clear by 17:00, and coaches are banned between 78.5 and 108.5 km. Rockfall brings extra closures, so check the highways bureau's notices before going.
The kilometre posts have moved as the road was rebuilt: Yakou was about 147.5 km before 2011 and is about 142 km now. Older guidebooks will not match the posts.
zh: 山区路段（梅山口至向阳的台 20 临 105 线）每周二、四不开放；其余日子仅 7 时至 14 时可进入，17 时前须全线净空；78.5 至 108.5 公里处禁止甲、乙类大客车通行。落石时另有临时管制，出发前应先查看公路局公告。
里程桩号随改线重建而变动：垭口在 2011 年以前约为 147.5K，复通后约为 142K。旧版旅游资料的里程与现场桩号对不上。

value.en: NT$311 million estimated at the start of work in 1968 (an earlier estimate was NT$290 million). No final outturn was found.
value.zh: 1968 年开工时概算新台币 3 亿 1,100 万元（此前一版概算为 2 亿 9,000 万元）；未找到最终决算数。

timeline.en: The province chooses the Tainan–Taitung line, then shelves it for lack of money.
timeline.zh: 省府选定台南至台东路线，随即因经费无着而搁置。

timeline.en: Chiang Kai-shek tells the provincial governor in May that the road should be built.
timeline.zh: 5 月，蒋中正指示省主席黄杰南横仍应修建。

timeline.en: Ground is broken at Beiliao on 5 July.
timeline.zh: 7 月 5 日，在北寮举行开工典礼。

timeline.en: The road is completed on 31 October and opened to traffic on 1 December.
timeline.zh: 10 月 31 日完工，12 月 1 日开放通车。

timeline.en: Asphalt paving begins, worked from both ends towards Yakou until 1996.
timeline.zh: 开始由两端向垭口分段铺设沥青路面，至 1996 年完成。

timeline.en: Mountain permit controls along the road are lifted.
timeline.zh: 解除山地管制，成为山地开放区。

timeline.en: Typhoon Morakot breaks the road in August.
timeline.zh: 8 月，莫拉克台风重创南横。

timeline.en: The Mingbakelu bridge opens on 29 April, replacing a riverbed detour.
timeline.zh: 4 月 29 日，明霸克露桥通车，取代河底便道。

timeline.en: Meishankou–Xiangyang is downgraded to a temporary road, Highway 20 Lin 105.
timeline.zh: 梅山口至向阳路段降级为临时便道台 20 临 105 线。

timeline.en: The whole road reopens on 1 May.
timeline.zh: 5 月 1 日，南横全线复通。
